parts.text: Which claim about antibiotics is correct?

options.text: Antibiotics treat bacterial infections; careless use can help resistant bacteria develop and make later infections harder to treat.
Any fever means an antibiotic should be started at once from leftover tablets.
Antibiotics grow stronger each time they are reused, so leftover tablets are safer than a new prescription.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Ishan has a sore throat and mild fever. A relative offers leftover antibiotic tablets from an old prescription. The doctor says not to take them unless a bacterial infection is diagnosed.

part_answers.answer: Antibiotics are for bacterial infections; using them carelessly can lead to resistance, so leftover tablets should not be taken without medical advice.

teacher.key_rationale: Antibiotics are for bacterial infections. Careless or leftover use can promote resistant bacteria and make future infections harder to treat.
